notes.title: MAJOR FREE UPDATE FOR SUPER STREET: THE GAME LIVE NOW
notes.content:
Get ready to come back to the world of street racing and tuning. The biggest free update for Super Street: The Game so far has rolled out! As you might have guessed from our announcement, this update introduces one of the most requested features: multiple car slots. Free up some space, as this means you’ll be able to own and work on nine builds at a time! To expand your garage, simply go to ‘car collection’ in the main menu and purchase a new slot per ride.

Next up, you can expect a whole load of new content to keep the road from scrap to tuner car fresh! First off, get ready for the the brand-new environment: Mexico City Centre! Race around the colorful streets and tear up the square of this world city to prove once more you’re the ultimate street racer! A new game mode, the introduction of difficulty settings, 20 all-new races and some other improvements round out this update!

You can find the complete content list for the update down below:

[b]New features[/b]
* Brand-New Environment: Mexico City Centre
* Functionality for multiple car slots 
* Implementation of difficulty settings available in settings
* Addition of 20 all-new races
* New Game Mode: Boss

[b]Fix[/b]
* Updated AI
* Rebalanced missions

Do you want to share your opinion about the new update, give suggestions for new updates or share the ride you’ve built? Join our official Discord channel and chat with us and other car enthusiasts! You can also contact us through our Facebook, Instagram or Twitter channels or mail us at: online@superstreet-thegame.com.

We thank you for all the feedback, involvement and support!

Team Super Street: The Game

notes.title: GET THE DECEMBER UPDATE FOR SUPER STREET: THE GAME NOW
notes.content:
Get ready to tear up the streets once more! As from today you can download the December update for Super Street: The Game! We bring you a brand-new supercar, an extra event and several more improvements to get you through the cold winter days. We all hope you will love these new additions.

You can find the complete update list below:

New features
* Brand-new K&N supercar
* All-new event with 5 races
* New car parts for specific cars

Gameplay adjustments
* Modified AI behavior
* Improvement of sound effects
* Improved visuals for various locations
* Minor bug fixes

[b]Big Christmas Promotion[/b]
Next to the release of the December update, we’re excited to share some other big news! As a special Christmas promotion, Super Street: The Game will be available at a 50% discount for a limited time! This promotion will start from the 20th of December and will run on all platforms. You can order it through our website. Get it now and start building your ultimate ride!

Do you want to share your opinion about the December update, give new suggestions for new updates or share the ride you’ve built? Join our official Discord channel and chat with us and other car enthusiasts! You can also contact us through our Facebook, Instagram or Twitter channels or mail us at: online@superstreet-thegame.com

We want to thank you for all the honest feedback, involvement and support we’ve received from all of you in 2018! We’re excited and look forward to bring even more updates to Super Street: The Game in 2019!

notes.title: First Update Super Street: The Game is released
notes.content:
Today we are happy to announce the release of the first update for Super Street: The Game.
Based on all the constructive feedback we recieved from the beginning, we immediately started to develop the very first update.

We hope we've addressed alot of the feedback and you will enjoy it. We appreciate every piece of feedback recieved and we will continue to improve the game! So many thanks from everybody from the Super Street: The Game team for your patience and support! We are looking forward on the new feedback so we can continue making Super Street: The Game a game for the community!

Team Super Street: The Game

Improvements:
* Updated car physics (understeer, handbrake, downforce/weight, and more)
* Engine sounds per engine
* Auto respawn when car is flipped
* Improved visual quality of car parts
* Update to UE 4.20
* Updated controller input for Nitro
* Updated AI balancing
* Polished car parts

Fix:
* Fixed localization bug Portuguese language
* Fixed no engine sounds and missing RPM when reversing

New features:
* Steam cloud saving (PC-Steam only)
* Easy restart career functionality
* Option to hide the crew members in the garage
* Option to toggle boost motion blur effect
* Simplified Chinese has been added

And many more smaller updates

notes.title: FIRST UPDATE COMING TO SUPER STREET: THE GAME
notes.content:
To start off with the most important thing: we want to give our sincere thanks from everyone that has been working on Super Street: The Game! We thank you for all of your honest feedback, involvement and support we received in the first week after the launch!

After working for two years on Super Street: The Game, it was very exciting for us to finally see it launch last week. We’ve been overwhelmed by all of your first reactions, experiences and feedback. We want to start off with one thing: positive or negative, we have heard you! We know that we need your help and support to keep Super Street: The Game growing into a better game for everyone. 

We are just at the beginning and there’s a lot more to come. Based on all the feedback we received, we immediately started to work on several important updates that we want to share with you today. After this update that’s coming in October, we are already planning the next big update in November. But more on that will be shared in the upcoming weeks!

For this first update, we have been working on:

Improvements
* Updated car physics (understeer, handbrake, downforce/weight, and more)
* Engine sounds per engine
* Auto respawn when car is flipped
* Improved visual quality of car parts
* Update to UE 4.20

Fix
* Localisation bug Portuguese language

New features
* Steam cloud saving (PC-Steam only)
* Easy restart career functionality
* Option to hide the crewmembers in the  garage
* Option to toggle boost motion blur effect

This is just the first update! There is also a big update planned that will arrive in November, so stay tuned to get more information about all of the new content you can expect!

Team Super Street: The Game
-
19 sep 2018
